scope: One independent review of original source pixels, complete current edition context, repaired full-resolution artwork, and actual 320 px preview. No repeated science review or promotion.

findings.finding: The crossed-arm assembly has two distinct hand forms: a clenched hand beside the image-left upper arm and a second central hand gripping the thermometer. The other arm also retains its hand hanging at the side. The gripping hand joins the same crossed assembly without a coherent second wrist or arm, producing an anatomically inconsistent extra hand.
findings.evidence: Visible in the full 1024x1536 repaired output and its in-memory arm detail: the clenched form is around x365..435, y590..660; the thermometer-gripping form is around x445..550, y545..625. The 320 px image reduces detail but does not resolve the malformed anatomy.
findings.consequence: The artwork is not acceptable as a clean instructional depiction even though the underarm placement repair is recognizable.

checks.sourceInventory: One standing clothed child, one forearm crossing the torso toward an underarm thermometer, the other arm down, trousers and two shoes; no readable scale or numerical value.
checks.underarmPlacement: pass: the upper end disappears at the inner sleeve/underarm junction, rather than terminating visibly on the outer shirt; the exposed stem points diagonally down toward the crossed hand. Hidden skin contact is not itself visible and no completed thermal equilibrium is inferred.
checks.anatomy: fail: duplicated hand assembly described in the finding.
checks.preview320: The person and diagonal underarm thermometer remain recognizable at 320x480; no text legibility requirement applies because there are no visible labels.
checks.scaleDataTimeRecommendation: pass: no scale ticks, numerical reading, time, clock, procedure text, or recommendation appears. Longitudinal glass highlights are not graduated scale marks.
checks.culturalNeutrality: pass: plain unbranded contemporary clothing, neutral expression and white background; no source cultural symbols or archival treatment.
checks.repairBudget: The supplied targeted repair has been reviewed and still fails the anatomy requirement; no additional repair attempted.
